(in-package :mcclim-browser)
(defun canvas-design-surface (medium design width height transformation)
  ;; Composite the design independently of the shape being drawn. In particular,
  ;; OUT removes pixels from this temporary design, never from existing drawing.
  ;; All layers use device coordinates so nested transforms and text positioning
  ;; do not move the design relative to its mask.
  (labels ((render (ink &optional (tr transformation))
             (canvas-design-surface medium ink width height tr))
           (combine (destination source operation)
             (canvas-set destination "globalCompositeOperation" operation)
             (canvas-call destination "drawImage" (property source "canvas") 0 0)
             (canvas-set destination "globalCompositeOperation" "source-over")
             destination)
           (fill (style)
             (let ((surface (host-call "createSurface" width height)))
               (canvas-set surface "fillStyle" style)
               (canvas-call surface "fillRect" 0 0 width height)
               surface)))
    (cond ((eq design +foreground-ink+) (render (medium-foreground medium)))
          ((eq design +background-ink+) (render (medium-background medium)))
          ((climi::indirect-ink-p design) (render (climi::indirect-ink-ink design)))
          ((typep design '(or color opacity climi::uniform-compositum))
           (let ((climi::*foreground-ink* (medium-foreground medium)))
             (fill (canvas-color medium design))))
          ((typep design 'clime:pattern)
           (fill (canvas-pattern medium design transformation)))
          ((typep design 'climi::transformed-design)
           (render (climi::transformed-design-design design)
                   (compose-transformations transformation
                    (climi::transformed-design-transformation design))))
          ((typep design 'climi::masked-compositum)
           (combine (render (climi::compositum-ink design))
                    (render (climi::compositum-mask design))
                    (if (typep design 'climi::in-compositum)
                        "destination-in" "destination-out")))
          ((typep design 'climi::over-compositum)
           (combine (render (climi::compositum-background design))
                    (render (climi::compositum-foreground design)) "source-over"))
          ((typep design 'region)
           (combine (render (medium-foreground medium))
                    (canvas-region-mask (transform-region transformation design) width height)
                    "destination-in"))
          (t (error "Canvas design is not yet supported: ~S" (type-of design))))))


;; Run through workbench.mjs after loading the current backend. These are real
;; upstream CLIM drawing calls rendered by OffscreenCanvas in the browser.
(defpackage #:valtan-canvas-checks (:use #:clim #:clim-lisp))
(in-package #:valtan-canvas-checks)
(defvar *checks* 0)
(defun pixel (surface x y)
  (let* ((context (mcclim-browser::property surface "context"))
         (image ((ffi:ref context "getImageData") x y 1 1))
         (data (ffi:ref image "data")))
    (loop for i below 4 collect (ffi:aget data i))))
(defun check-pixel (surface x y expected)
  (let ((actual (pixel surface x y)))
    (assert (equal actual expected) () "Pixel (~D,~D): expected ~S, got ~S" x y expected actual)
    (incf *checks*)))

(let* ((surface (mcclim-browser::host-call "createSurface" 20 20))
       (medium (make-instance 'mcclim-browser:browser-medium
                              :port (find-port :server-path '(:browser))))
       (red (make-rgb-color 1 0 0)) (green (make-rgb-color 0 1 0))
       (blue (make-rgb-color 0 0 1)))
  (setf (climi::medium-drawable medium) surface *checks* 0)
  (flet ((clear ()
           (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) +everywhere+)
           (mcclim-browser::canvas-call medium "clearRect" 0 0 20 20))
         (fill-red () (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :ink red :filled t)))
    (let ((pattern (make-pattern #2A((0 1) (2 3)) (vector red green blue +transparent-ink+))))
      (draw-pattern* medium pattern 3 4)
      (check-pixel surface 3 4 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 4 4 '(0 255 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 3 5 '(0 0 255 255))
      (check-pixel surface 4 5 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 5 4 '(0 0 0 0))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                       :ink (make-rectangular-tile pattern 2 2))
      (check-pixel surface 12 12 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 13 12 '(0 255 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 12 13 '(0 0 255 255)))
    (clear)
    (let* ((storage (make-array 4 :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32)
                                  :initial-contents '(0 #xffff0000 #xff0000ff 0)))
           (array (make-array '(1 2) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 32)
                                    :displaced-to storage :displaced-index-offset 1))
           (pattern (make-pattern array nil)))
      (draw-pattern* medium pattern 0 0)
      (check-pixel surface 0 0 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 1 0 '(0 0 255 255))
      (setf (aref storage 1) #xff00ff00)
      (draw-pattern* medium pattern 0 0)
      (check-pixel surface 0 0 '(0 255 0 255))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                       :ink (transform-region (make-translation-transformation 5 6) pattern))
      (check-pixel surface 5 6 '(0 255 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 0 255 255))
      (check-pixel surface 0 0 '(0 0 0 0)))
    (clear)
    (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink +white+)
    (draw-pattern* medium (make-pattern #2A((0))
                                       (vector (compose-in red (make-opacity 1/2)))) 0 0)
    (check-pixel surface 0 0 '(255 128 128 255))
    (clear)
    (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) (make-ellipse* 8 8 6 0 0 4))
    (fill-red)
    (check-pixel surface 8 8 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 0 0 '(0 0 0 0))
    (check-pixel surface 8 2 '(0 0 0 0))
    (clear)
    (setf (medium-clipping-region medium)
          (make-instance 'climi::standard-region-intersection
                         :regions (list (make-ellipse* 8 8 6 0 0 4)
                                        (make-rectangle* 8 0 20 20))))
    (fill-red)
    (check-pixel surface 5 8 '(0 0 0 0))
    (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 18 8 '(0 0 0 0))
    (clear)
    (setf (medium-clipping-region medium)
          (make-instance 'climi::standard-region-union
                         :regions (list (make-polygon* '(2 2 10 2 10 10 2 10))
                                        (make-polygon* '(6 6 6 14 14 14 14 6)))))
    (fill-red)
    (check-pixel surface 3 3 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 8 8 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 12 12 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 16 16 '(0 0 0 0))
    (clear)
    (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) (climi::region-complement (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12)))
    (fill-red)
    (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 8 8 '(0 0 0 0))
    (clear)
    ;; A union containing an intersection cannot be represented by simply
    ;; concatenating paths or by applying sequential Canvas clips.
    (let* ((intersection (make-instance 'climi::standard-region-intersection
                          :regions (list (make-ellipse* 8 8 6 0 0 4)
                                         (make-rectangle* 8 0 20 20))))
           (union (make-instance 'climi::standard-region-union
                    :regions (list intersection (make-rectangle* 1 1 3 3)))))
      (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) union)
      (fill-red)
      (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 5 8 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 18 8 '(0 0 0 0))
      (clear)
      (setf (medium-clipping-region medium)
            (make-instance 'climi::standard-region-complement :complement union))
      (fill-red)
      (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 5 8 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 18 8 '(255 0 0 255))
      ;; Overlapping union members must not paint semitransparent ink twice.
      (clear)
      (setf (medium-clipping-region medium)
            (make-instance 'climi::standard-region-union
              :regions (list intersection (make-rectangle* 8 6 12 10))))
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                       :ink (compose-in red (make-opacity 1/2)))
      (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(255 0 0 128))
      (check-pixel surface 5 8 '(0 0 0 0))
      ;; The mask is in device coordinates even when the drawing is translated.
      (clear)
      (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) union)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 2 2 :filled t :ink blue
                       :transformation (make-translation-transformation 9 7))
      (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(0 0 255 255))
      (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(0 0 0 0)))
    (clear)
    ;; Spatial composite designs must be resolved independently of existing
    ;; destination pixels and then clipped to the geometry being drawn.
    (let* ((box (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12))
           (red-box (compose-in red box))
           (blue-box (compose-in blue (make-rectangle* 8 8 16 16))))
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink red-box)
      (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 14 14 '(0 0 0 0))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink blue)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-out red box))
      (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 0 255 255))
      (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 14 14 '(255 0 0 255))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-over red-box blue-box))
      (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 10 10 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 14 14 '(0 0 255 255))
      (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(0 0 0 0))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                       :ink (compose-over (compose-in red-box (make-opacity 1/2)) blue-box))
      (check-pixel surface 10 10 '(128 0 127 255))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                       :ink (transform-region (make-translation-transformation 4 2) red-box))
      (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 18 18 '(0 0 0 0))
      (clear)
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink red-box
                       :transformation (make-translation-transformation 4 2))
      (check-pixel surface 10 8 '(255 0 0 255))
      ;; A drawing transformation moves the shape, not the supplied ink.
      (check-pixel surface 14 8 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 18 18 '(0 0 0 0))
      (clear)
      (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) (make-rectangle* 0 0 8 20))
      (draw-rectangle* medium 6 0 20 20 :filled t :ink red-box)
      (check-pixel surface 7 6 '(255 0 0 255))
      (check-pixel surface 10 6 '(0 0 0 0)))
    (clear)
    (let ((stencil (make-pattern #2A((0 1))
                                (vector (make-opacity 1/2) +transparent-ink+))))
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                       :ink (compose-in green (make-rectangular-tile stencil 2 1)))
      (check-pixel surface 4 4 '(0 255 0 127))
      (check-pixel surface 5 4 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 18 18 '(0 255 0 127)))
    ;; CLIM stencil opacity uses opaque black foreground/background, even when
    ;; the actual foreground is translucent. The medium background stays opaque.
    (let ((foreground (medium-foreground medium))
          (background (medium-background medium))
          (box (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12))
          (palette (make-rectangular-tile
                    (make-pattern #2A((0 1)) (vector +foreground-ink+ +background-ink+)) 2 1))
          (stripe (make-rectangular-tile
                   (make-pattern #2A((0 1)) (vector +foreground-ink+ +transparent-ink+)) 2 1)))
      (unwind-protect
           (progn
             (setf (medium-foreground medium) (compose-in red (make-opacity 1/2))
                   (medium-background medium) blue)
             (clear)
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-in red box))
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(255 0 0 255))
             (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(0 0 0 0))
             (clear)
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-out red box))
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 0 0 0))
             (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(255 0 0 255))
             (clear)
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink palette)
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(255 0 0 127))
             (check-pixel surface 7 6 '(0 0 255 255))
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-in green palette))
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 255 0 255))
             (check-pixel surface 7 6 '(0 255 0 255))
             (clear)
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-out green palette))
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 0 0 0))
             (check-pixel surface 7 6 '(0 0 0 0))
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (compose-in green stripe))
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 255 0 255))
             (check-pixel surface 7 6 '(0 0 0 0))
             (clear)
             (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                              :ink (compose-in (compose-in green box)
                                               (transform-region (make-translation-transformation 1 0) stripe)))
             (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 0 0 0))
             (check-pixel surface 7 6 '(0 255 0 255)))
        (setf (medium-foreground medium) foreground
              (medium-background medium) background)))
    (clear)
    (setf (medium-foreground medium) green)
    (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12))
    (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 255 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 2 2 '(0 0 0 0))
    (clear)
    (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                     :ink (compose-in (make-opacity 1/2) (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12)))
    (check-pixel surface 6 6 '(0 255 0 128))
    (clear)
    (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t
                     :transformation (make-translation-transformation 3 2)
                     :ink (make-rectangular-tile
                           (make-pattern #2A((0 1)) (vector red blue)) 2 1))
    (check-pixel surface 4 4 '(255 0 0 255))
    (check-pixel surface 5 4 '(0 0 255 255))
    (check-pixel surface 2 4 '(0 0 0 0))
    ;; Text positioning changes the Canvas transform internally. The design
    ;; must still use drawing-plane coordinates, exactly like explicit clipping.
    (clear)
    (let ((box (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12)))
      ;; Use white for the reference coverage: Canvas text antialiasing can
      ;; depend on ink luminance, and the composite path uses a white mask.
      (draw-text* medium "M" 3 15 :text-size 16 :ink +white+ :clipping-region box)
      (let ((reference (loop for y below 20 append
                             (loop for x below 20
                                   for alpha = (fourth (pixel surface x y))
                                   collect (if (zerop alpha) '(0 0 0 0)
                                               (list 255 0 0 alpha))))))
        (assert (some (lambda (rgba) (plusp (fourth rgba))) reference))
        (clear)
        (draw-text* medium "M" 3 15 :text-size 16 :ink (compose-in red box))
        (assert (equal reference (loop for y below 20 append
                                       (loop for x below 20 collect (pixel surface x y)))))
        (incf *checks*)))
    (clear)
    ;; Drei redisplay can retain zero-width/height bands alongside valid ones.
    ;; MAP-OVER-REGION-SET-REGIONS returns +NOWHERE+ for those empty components.
    (let ((region (make-instance 'climi::standard-rectangle-set
                    :bands '((1 3 9) (6) (8 1 1) (8) (10 1 1) (10)))))
      (assert (member +nowhere+ (region-set-regions region)))
      (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 20 20 :filled t :ink blue :clipping-region region)
      (check-pixel surface 4 2 '(0 0 255 255))
      (check-pixel surface 1 8 '(0 0 0 0))
      (check-pixel surface 14 14 '(0 0 0 0)))
    (clear)
    (setf (medium-clipping-region medium) +nowhere+)
    (fill-red)
    (check-pixel surface 8 8 '(0 0 0 0))))
(format t "~&MCCLIM-CANVAS-CHECKS-PASS ~D~%" *checks*)
(values :passed *checks*)
